schema: see mods/README.md -- building.json bBuildingDefList subset + mod extensions

bBuildingDefList.name: PAirlockDoor
bBuildingDefList.description: Sucking Duplicants that have nowhere to go into space through Mechanized Airlocks is poor taste. Airlock Doors now allow Duplicants safe passage without the loss of any of their mysterious fluids.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Blocks Liquid and Gas flow, even while Duplicants are passing.

Will not allow passage when no Power is available.

Critters can never pass through this door.
bBuildingDefList.notes: PLib PBuilding. Stores 10000 J internally, 1500 J per use (AirlockDoor component). Logic port: Unlock/Lock at (0,0).

bBuildingDefList.name: PAirlockDoorInsulated
bBuildingDefList.description: Sucking Duplicants that have nowhere to go into space through Insulated Doors is poor taste. Insulated Airlock Doors now allow Duplicants safe passage without the loss of any of their mysterious fluids.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Blocks Liquid and Gas flow, even while Duplicants are passing.

Will not allow passage when no Power is available.

Critters can never pass through this door.

Heat flow through this door is greatly reduced.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Same behavior as PAirlockDoor; insulated variant. Ingredient tiers: Insulator TIER4 (400 kg), RefinedMetal TIER2 (100 kg).

bBuildingDefList.name: Drain
bBuildingDefList.description: 9 out of 10 plumbers recommend Drain® for its uncloggability. Our new Drain® companion product, Clog-Be-Gone™, will hit shelves soon. Now less likely to vaporize unexpectedly during normal operation!
bBuildingDefList.effect: Slowly drains liquids into a pipe.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Option-dependent (PLib options, defaults used here): UseSolidDrain=false selects drain_kanim / non-solid tile; true selects solidDrain_kanim, isSolidTile=true, and samples the cell above. FlowRate (default 0.1 kg/s, range 0.1-1.0) sets ElementConsumer.consumptionRate. Foundation tile that passively drinks the liquid in its cell into a liquid pipe.

bBuildingDefList.name: NaturalTile
bBuildingDefList.description: Fill that hole you dug out back in with any solid element.
bBuildingDefList.effect: Fills a block in the world with Solids.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Buildable from any Solid element. On construction complete, the building deletes itself and places a natural block of the chosen element (mass = BlockMass) in the cell, displacing pickupables. Option-dependent (config.json next to DLL, defaults used here): BuildMass=50 -> materialMass, BuildSpeed=3 -> constructionTime, BlockMass=50 -> placed block mass. Registered to tech via the tech containing RationBox (FarmingTech in current build); appended to the end of the Base plan menu.

bBuildingDefList.name: PressureGasPump
bBuildingDefList.description: An advanced pump that perform mechanical work to compress and move gases. More powerful than the standard pump, this one is capable of moving large amounts of gases, although this is only archived through the High Pressure Gas Pipe.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Draws in Gas and runs it through High Pressure Gas Pipe.

Must be submerged in Gas.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Option-dependent (PLib options, defaults used here): HPGas (default 10, range 2-10) sets pump rate (kg/s), storage capacity, and wattage = HPGas * 240 (default 2400 W).

bBuildingDefList.name: PressureLiquidPump
bBuildingDefList.description: An advanced pump that perform mechanical work to compress and move fluids. More powerful than the standard pump, this one is capable of moving large amounts of liquids, although this is only archived through the High Pressure Liquid Pipe.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Draws in Liquid and runs it through High Pressure Liquid Pipe.

Must be submerged in Liquid.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Option-dependent (PLib options, defaults used here): HPLiquid (default 40, range 11-100) sets pump rate (kg/s), storage capacity, and wattage = HPLiquid * 24 (default 960 W).

bBuildingDefList.name: HighPressureGasConduit
bBuildingDefList.description: A reinforced gas pipe capable of handling high pressure flow. Composite nature of the pipe prevents gas contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Carries a maximum of 10kg of Gas with minimal change in Temperature.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Transport segment (utilities[] empty by convention, like vanilla GasConduit). Capacity = HPGas option (default 10 kg). Connects to the standard gas-conduit network; capacity is enforced by Harmony transpilers on ConduitFlow.

bBuildingDefList.name: HighPressureGasConduitBridge
bBuildingDefList.description: A reinforced gas pipe bridge capable of handling high pressure flow. Composite nature of the pipe prevents gas contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Runs one High Pressure Gas Pipe section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Bridge: input/output ports are the two ends; flow is bidirectional.

bBuildingDefList.name: HighPressureLiquidConduit
bBuildingDefList.description: A reinforced liquid pipe capable of handling high pressure flow. Composite nature of the pipe prevents liquid contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Carries a maximum of 40kg of Liquid with minimal change in Temperature.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Transport segment (utilities[] empty by convention). Capacity = HPLiquid option (default 40 kg). Config sets ThermalConductivity twice (1.3 then 1e-05); the final value 1e-05 wins.

bBuildingDefList.name: HighPressureLiquidConduitBridge
bBuildingDefList.description: A reinforced liquid pipe bridge capable of handling high pressure flow. Composite nature of the pipe prevents liquid contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Runs one High Pressure Liquid Pipe section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Bridge: input/output ports are the two ends; flow is bidirectional.

bBuildingDefList.name: DecompressionGasValve
bBuildingDefList.description: A mechanical valve capable of reducing the flow of gas from a pressurized pipe to a normal pipe, avoid it to break.
bBuildingDefList.effect: Allows Gases to be transfered from High Pressure Gas Pipe to normal Pipes.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Reservoir-style step-down valve: buffers up to 10 kg of gas and dispenses into a normal pipe at normal rates.

bBuildingDefList.name: DecompressionLiquidValve
bBuildingDefList.description: A mechanical valve capable of reducing the flow of liquid from a pressurized pipe to a normal pipe, avoid it to break.
bBuildingDefList.effect: Allows Liquid to be transfered from High Pressure Liquid Pipe to normal Pipes.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Reservoir-style step-down valve: buffers up to 40 kg of liquid and dispenses into a normal pipe at normal rates.

bBuildingDefList.name: MJSplitterMKIIGas
bBuildingDefList.description: All elements are sent into the building's output, except the elements chosen for filtering.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Allows you to select multiple filter elements simultaneously.

Unfiltered items will remain in the output.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Multi-element filter (like vanilla GasFilter but with multi-select via TreeFilterable). Filtered elements exit the secondary port at (0,0); everything else passes through to (1,0).

bBuildingDefList.name: MJSplitterMKIILiquid
bBuildingDefList.description: All elements are sent into the building's output, except the elements chosen for filtering.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Allows you to select multiple filter elements simultaneously.

Unfiltered items will remain in the output.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Multi-element filter (like vanilla LiquidFilter but with multi-select via TreeFilterable). Filtered elements exit the secondary port at (0,0); everything else passes through to (1,0).

bBuildingDefList.name: MJSplitterMKIISolid
bBuildingDefList.description: All elements are sent into the building's output, except the elements chosen for filtering.
bBuildingDefList.effect:
Allows you to select multiple filter elements simultaneously.

Unfiltered items will remain in the output.
bBuildingDefList.notes: Multi-item conveyor filter (like vanilla SolidFilter but with multi-select via TreeFilterable). Filtered items exit the secondary port at (0,0); everything else passes through to (1,0).
